title: 第269章 防守一波？是放手一搏！

第(1/3)页

“卧槽！哪打的我？卧槽，牢区还有一队满编！”

杨起家的屏幕瞬间变暗，正前方的倒地视角与先前美美吃包的画面形成了鲜明的对比。

没错，刚才的他还整个人维持着趴在包上翻东西的姿势，还想着怎么理包更合适呢，

但现在他的脑子里却变成了一片空白。

他刚才还在想着三千万收益出素材能搞很多点赞呢！

刚才还在那畅想着这把撤离出去要狠狠跟水友吹牛逼呢！

结果就这么——啪——被人一狙爆头了？

“我他妈的！”

“啊！！”

杨起家一巴掌拍在了桌子上，那声响隔着屏幕都能让人感觉到震动。

他的脸上写满了痛彻心扉的痛，

虽然被自己一手摸到的曼德尔超算在保险里，

但他身上背的枪却一把比一把贵，加在一起都快比得上两个曼德尔了，

结果这一下就全没了？

不，他还有机会！

杨起家还有最后一丝理智在运转，视线下意识就看向了蜂医所在的方向。

对方就在他身后不到十米的位置，应该是刚翻完另一个包。

只要对方来的够快，他就还能起得来！

没错，类似蜂医这样的支援位干员，他们的被动就是救人特快。

尤其是蜂医本身，救起来更是能回一大截血，

直接就可以让他不用着急打药而是去架枪或者压道具！

但他的想法还没来得及完全成型和说出口呢，耳机里就传来了密集的脚步声和枪声。

是这一队的队友来了，怎么会这么快？

好家伙，偷个屁股还给他们分工明确，还一个偷剩下两个摸起来了？

“不——”

杨起家的角色甚至还没来得及向后爬出三步，就彻底被人补掉进入观战视角了。

【哈哈哈哈！】

【三千万呢杨哥？你的三千万呢？】

【传下去，杨区家三千万单局收入，已确认！（）】

【笑死了，这就是“终日大雁却还是被雁啄了眼”啊！你刚修完人脚不到一分钟就被人偷了！】

【杨哥你就直说吧，是不是不想把保险里的曼德尔超算给人家？故意站那挨枪的？】

【我觉得有道理，他就是舍不得那个超算，想着死了保险就锁了对面拿不走！】

【你们这就冤枉杨哥了，人家这叫——战略性阵亡！】

【纯纯战犯吗这不是！】

【弹幕太会串了，但我说实话，这波确实是杨哥贪了，包都舔完了还不走，站沙地中间当靶子呢？】

杨起家看着满屏的弹幕，那股子气啊是直冲天灵盖！

他想骂人！他想反驳！他想说自己刚才如果直接就走的话，弹幕绝对会有一大堆人喷他理包！

怎么现在就是不一样的说法了？

但是——

现在不是和弹幕较劲的时候。

“蜂医哥！跑！快跑！这一队是满编！”

他一边喊着，一边飞速在脑子里组织着逃生路线。

“从我们来时的铁门走，然后开一员的卡，最后钻鼠道！”

“这把咱们干脆就丢包得了，虽然吃的少了点但至少成功撤离了不是？”

“而且到时候你就一边跑一边藏一下东西，这样他们也就吃不了多少了！”

没办法，在杨起家的刻板印象里，

蜂医——不，准确说是“绿裤子”这个角色，他的核心标签就是跑刀。

除此之外最后也就是修修脚，根本干不了猛攻，

所以他此时的建议也都是针对跑路为第一前提才说出口的。

但反观蜂医那边似乎沉默了一秒，显得有一点点犹豫。

在他还想开口说些什么的时候，杨起家却先一步把话堵死了。

“快跑啊哥，真别让他们爽吃了吧！”

杨起家急的声音都劈了，而也是听到了这里，蜂医最终还是选择了听劝。

但很明显对面那队人并不打算就此放手。

砰砰砰砰——！

明明他为了撤离都已经拉出去长烟了，这群人也还是在那死追不放，甚至不惜浪费子弹的去混烟，让杨起家都看无语了！

“草！这群人也太狠了吧！”

更让他心里一沉的是——在烟雾开始消散的瞬间，对面那个打了他头的露娜手里竟然直接就甩出了一把侦察箭矢！

那支发着微光的箭矢精准地射入天穹，红色光芒洒落地面，一下子就又把刚才丢失了些许视野的蜂医重新照了出来！

"Damn it! How could you beat me? Damn it, there is a full team in the cell area!"

Yang Qijia's screen instantly dimmed, and the perspective of the man lying on the ground in front was in sharp contrast to the previous scene of Meimei eating buns.

That's right, just now he was still lying on the bag rummaging through things, and he was still thinking about how to organize the bag more appropriately.

But now his mind went blank.

He was thinking just now that the 30 million yuan in revenue and the material would get a lot of likes!

Just now, I was thinking about how I would brag about my evacuation to my water friends!

The result was just like that - snap - shot in the head with a sniper?

"Holy shit!"

"Ah!!"

Yang Qijia slapped the table, and the sound could be felt through the screen.

His face was filled with heart-wrenching pain,

Although Mandel, who was touched by his own hand, was covered by insurance,

But the guns he carried were more expensive than the last, and together they were almost as valuable as two Mandels.

As a result, it was all gone at once?

No, he still has a chance!

Yang Qijia still had the last trace of reason running, so he subconsciously looked in the direction of the bee doctor.

The other party was less than ten meters behind him, and he must have just finished looking through another bag.

As long as the other party comes quickly enough, he can still get up!

That's right, for support operators like Bee Doctor, their passive is to rescue people.

Especially the bee doctors themselves can recover a large amount of blood after rescuing them.

This way, he doesn't have to worry about spraying medicine, but instead sets up guns or presses props!

But before his thoughts could be fully formed and spoken, the sound of intensive footsteps and gunshots came from the headphones.

A teammate from this team is here, how come it’s so fast?

Good guy, you stole someone's ass and gave them a clear division of labor, but one of them stole and the other two touched it?

"No-"

Before Yang Qijia's character even had time to crawl back three steps, he was completely replaced and entered the spectator's perspective.

【Ha ha ha ha!】

[What about 30 million, Brother Yang?Where is your 30 million?】

[Pass it down, Yang District’s family’s income of 30 million per game has been confirmed!()]

[It’s so funny, this is like “flying wild geese all day long but still getting pecked in the eye”!You just had your feet repaired and within a minute they were stolen!】

[Brother Yang, just tell me, do you not want to give others the Mandel super calculation in the insurance?Standing there to get shot on purpose?】

[I think it makes sense. He just couldn’t bear to part with that supercomputer. Thinking that the insurance would be dead, he locked it and couldn’t take it away!】

[You have wronged Brother Yang. This is called strategic death!】

【Are you a pure war criminal? This is not the case!】

[The barrage is so good, but to be honest, this time it’s Brother Yang who is really greedy. He didn’t leave even after licking the bag. How about standing in the middle of the sand as a target?】

Yang Qijia looked at the barrage that filled the screen, and his anger went straight to Tianling Gai!

He wants to curse!He wants to refute!He wanted to say that if he had left just now, there would definitely be a lot of people in the barrage criticizing him!

Why is it said differently now?

But——

Now is not the time to compete with barrages.

"Brother Bee Doctor! Run! Run quickly! This team is full!"

As he shouted, he quickly organized an escape route in his mind.

"Go through the iron gate where we came from, then open a member's card, and finally enter the rat path!"

"We just lost everything this time. Although we didn't eat much, at least we evacuated successfully, right?"

"And when the time comes, just run and hide the food at the same time, so they won't be able to eat much!"

There is no way, in Yang Qijia's stereotype,

Bee doctor - no, to be precise, the character "Green Pants", his core label is the running knife.

Apart from that, the last thing I did was a pedicure, and I couldn’t do the onslaught at all.

Therefore, his suggestions at this time were all premised on running away.

But on the other hand, the bee doctor seemed to be silent for a second, and seemed a little hesitant.

When he was about to say something, Yang Qijia blocked his words first.

"Run quickly, brother, don't let them enjoy it!"

Yang Qi's anxious voice broke down, but after hearing this, the bee doctor finally chose to listen to the advice.

But it was obvious that the team on the opposite side did not intend to let go.

Bang bang bang bang—!

Even though he had already been pulled out to smoke in order to evacuate, this group of people still kept chasing him, even wasting bullets to mix up the smoke, which made Yang Qijia speechless!

"Fuck! These people are too cruel!"

What made his heart sink even more was that at the moment when the smoke began to dissipate, Luna who hit him on the head from the opposite side actually threw out a scout arrow from her hand!

The shimmering arrow accurately shot into the sky, and the red light fell on the ground, suddenly re-illuminating the bee doctor who had lost some of his vision just now!
